title: Ethereum leverage crashes 91%, yet ETH price holds firm – Here’s why
summary: Ethereum’s market structure is shifting as institutional accumulation grows, speculative leverage fades, and whale activity introduces new supply pressure.
content: Ethereum's market structure is currently undergoing a significant shift. Recent data indicates that speculative leverage has dropped sharply by 91 percent. Despite this massive reduction in leveraged positions, the price of ETH has managed to hold its ground firmly. Market analysts point to growing institutional accumulation and notable whale activity as key factors influencing supply pressure and supporting the asset's resilience.

title: Singapore commits S$220m to fintech innovation
summary: The Monetary Authority of Singapore will pump S$220 million (US$173 million) over the next three years into the island's fintech ecosystem.
content: The Monetary Authority of Singapore has announced a significant funding commitment of S$220 million to support innovation within the local financial technology sector. The substantial investment is scheduled to be deployed over the next three years to further develop and strengthen the island nation's growing fintech ecosystem.
